2607.29243.title: TAVI-TEC: An AI-Based Tool for Procedural Planning of Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation
2607.29243.paper_summary: Computed tomography angiography (CTA) is crucial for preprocedural TAVI planning, providing the anatomical information required for prosthesis sizing and vascular access assessment. As the volume of TAVI procedure increases, improving efficiency and standardizing annotations is becoming essential in clinical practice. This study presents TAVI-TEC, a fully automated artificial intelligence-based framework integrated into a web based DICOM viewer for routine preoperative TAVI planning. Pre-procedural CTA scans from patients undergoing TAVI with SAPIEN 3 Ultra (S3U) prostheses were processed using a fully automated pipeline. Deep learning-based segmentation of cardiovascular structures, calcification detection, centerline extraction, landmark identification, and annular plane definition was implemented to quantify key annular and aortic root measurements and color-coded maps of lumen reduction and vessel diameter for vascular access. A multilayer perceptron classifier was trained to predict prosthesis size prior to the TAVI procedure. Results revealed that TAVI-TEC enabled pre-procedural measurements in approximately 2-6 min. Strong agreement with clinician-derived measurements was observed for annular area (coefficient of concordance, CCC = 0.934; interclass correlation coefficient, ICC = 0.935; R^2 = 0.881) and perimeter (CCC = 0.909; ICC = 0.909; R^2 = 0.854). The valve-size prediction model achieved 82% overall accuracy, with most misclassifications occurring between adjacent prosthesis sizes. Though further multicenter validation and extension to additional measurements and valve platforms are required, the TAVI-TEC methodology may reduce operator variability in pre-TAVI measurements and streamline the preoperative workflows of the Heart Team for decision-making.
2607.29243.paper_summary_zh: 計算機斷層血管造影 (CTA) 對於 TAVI 介入前的計劃至關重要，提供了進行假體尺寸和血管通路評估所需的解剖信息。隨著 TAVI 手術量的增加，提高效率和標準化註釋在臨床實踐中變得越來越重要。本研究提出了 TAVI-TEC，一個完全自動化的基於人工智能的框架，集成在一個基於網頁的 DICOM 查看器中，用於常規的術前 TAVI 計劃。對接受 SAPIEN 3 Ultra (S3U) 假體的 TAVI 患者的術前 CTA 掃描進行了使用完全自動化流程的處理。實施了基於深度學習的心血管結構分割、鈣化檢測、中心線提取、地標識別和環形平面定義，以量化關鍵的環形和主動脈根部測量以及血管通路的腔道縮小和血管直徑的彩色編碼圖。訓練了一個多層感知器分類器，以預測 TAVI 手術前的假體尺寸。結果顯示，TAVI-TEC 能夠在大約 2-6 分鐘內進行術前測量。對於環形面積（協調係數，CCC = 0.934；類內相關係數，ICC = 0.935；R^2 = 0.881）和周長（CCC = 0.909；ICC = 0.909；R^2 = 0.854）觀察到與臨床醫生測量結果的高度一致。閥門尺寸預測模型的整體準確率達到 82%，大多數錯誤分類發生在相鄰的假體尺寸之間。儘管需要進一步的多中心驗證以及擴展到其他測量和閥門平台，TAVI-TEC 方法論可能減少 TAVI 前測量中的操作者變異性，並簡化心臟團隊的術前工作流程以進行決策。
